column1: # Committed performance baseline. Regenerate deliberately with `make bench-update`; never hand-edited.
# Recorded from CI (the supported toolchain: the devcontainer / Actions image).
# A local run that reports +251% on site-bytes is measuring a *different*
# build: Starlight's Pagefind index is generated through npx, so a machine
# without node on PATH silently ships a smaller site. See PITFALLS-style note
# in the ADR - measure where CI measures.
